name: 000-dagric-flatpak-system-helper
description: Dagric ships and enables this: the root helper that performs system-wide Flatpak installs and updates. /usr/bin/flatpak is the command the owner or the first-run wizard types; this is the privileged process that does the actual downloading, and it is never started by hand, so a prompt for it names a program the owner has never heard of. Delete this file to be asked about it.
